risks.risk: Host capacity with memory_gb:auto is recorded as SKIPPED_WITH_REASON until runtime preflight can probe real host capacity.
risks.notes: Numeric host capacity is enforceable in current planner code and focused probes confirmed zero numeric capacity fails planning.

rationale: All manifest gates ran and passed, command text matches the manifest, gate logs exist with matching SHA256 values, required artifacts exist and validate against schemas, P02 is fake-only with no real Valkey requirement, safety scans are clean, and planner behavior covers deterministic AZ-aware placement, host assignment and numeric capacity enforcement, unique ports and names, marked non-HA single-AZ acceptance, unmarked single-AZ replica rejection, and 1000-node opt-in dry-run planning without execution.
